verdict.rationale: A recorded real-world probe shows an actual non-interactive, keyless, end-to-end skill install (`npx -y skills add anthropics/skills --skill skill-creator -a claude-code -y --copy`) that fetched the official repo and installed a spec-conformant SKILL.md with no prompts or account needed, confirming headless installability is achievable. However, this relies on third-party npx tooling rather than a documented first-party Anthropic CLI flag for non-interactive `/plugin install` or skill install inside Claude Code itself. Missing for 10: first-party documented non-interactive/headless install command from Anthropic's own CLI, and independent corroboration beyond one recorded probe run.
